bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for Silver Bay Trailhead and trail development at Redhead Mountain Bike Park.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SILVER BAY TRAILHEAD. +]

[+$400,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the city of Silver Bay for construction of the Silver Bay Trailhead. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION; REDHEAD MOUNTAIN BIKE PARK. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the city of Chisolm for trail development, maintenance, and related amenities at Redhead Mountain Bike Park. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for Silver Bay Trailhead and trail development at Redhead Mountain Bike Park.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SILVER BAY TRAILHEAD.

$400,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the city of Silver Bay for construction of the Silver Bay Trailhead.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; REDHEAD MOUNTAIN BIKE PARK.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the city of Chisolm for trail development, maintenance, and related amenities at Redhead Mountain Bike Park.
additions: $400,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the city of Silver Bay for construction of the Silver Bay Trailhead.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the city of Chisolm for trail development, maintenance, and related amenities at Redhead Mountain Bike Park.
